info.name: DayChallenge API - Phase 12 Dashboard & Statistics
info.description: Final phase endpoints for mobile dashboard aggregation and reporting statistics.

request.description: Returns the authenticated user's mobile dashboard overview: profile, active challenge, today progress, coins, streaks, weekly/monthly progress, and achievements.

response.name: Success

query.description: Optional: weekly, monthly, yearly. Defaults to monthly.

request.description: Returns reporting statistics for the selected period, including completion, tasks, streaks, coins, and challenges.

response.name: Validation Error
